photo.title: Village in Bunyoro, with four men in the foreground. Buchta visited Bunyoro during January to March of 1879.
A group of four Nyoro men, possibly near Kodj on the Nile where a chief, Ruyonga (Rionga), had his court and which Buchta visited during January to March of 1879.

A vignette full face portrait of Nakatshupi, the sister of chief Ruyonga (Rionga). It seems that the king's settlement was near Kodj on the Nile, upstream from Foweira, which Buchta visited in January to March of 1879.

A group of three Nyoro, possibly near Kodj on the Nile where a chief, Ruyonga (Rionga), had his court, and which Buchta visited during January to March of 1879. Two are playing harps, the boy in between them a drum.
A full face upper body portrait of a Nyoro girl.
Full length profile portrait of a woman with barkcloth skirt, bead waist ornaments.

A full length portrait of two women wrapped in barkcloth. The woman to the right is Nakatshupi, the sister of chief Ruyonga (Rionga), and to the left a woman called Kagaja, possibly her niece (Ruyonga's daughter). It seems that the king's settlement was near Kodj on the Nile, upstream from Foweira. Buchta visited Bunyoro between January and March of 1879.

A full length portrait of two men holding spears and hide shields. It seems that the king's settlement was near Kodj on the Nile, upstream from Foweira. Buchta visited Bunyoro between January and March of 1879.
A vignette profile portrait of Nakatshupi, the sister of chief Ruyonga (Rionga). It seems that the king's settlement was near Kodj on the Nile, upstream from Foweira.
A profile upper body portrait of a Nyoro girl.
Full length portrait of a man with spear, bow and arrows.
